messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: embeddings-api high 5xx rate (us-west-2). PD: https://pd.example/PN12345 — auto-escalation to oncall.

michael: acked — I'm on it. Starting triage.

alice: seeing same in logs, large number of 504/502 from embed-worker.

pagerbot: alert details: 5xx spike started 2m ago, peak 37% error-rate, p50 latency 120ms, p95 980ms. Impact: embed calls failing for batch endpoints.

michael: quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embed` -> several embed-worker-2 pods in CrashLoopBackOff.

alice: logs from embed-worker-2: ```
panic: kvcache: eviction flood: too many open segments
stack: runtime.go:235
...
error: failed to forward to model-server: upstream closed connection
```

sam: we rolled the quantized-llama variant into shadow routing earlier today (rollout id: rollout/qz-embeds-2026-03). Could be related.

michael: toggling shadow routing off for the rollout to see if errors fall (runbook step 3). Doing: `infra-router cli set-shadow-routing --service embeddings-api --rollout off`

alice: command completed. Watching metrics.

pagerbot: routing change applied.

michael: restarting crashed pods to clear state: `kubectl delete pod embed-worker-2-xxxxx -n inference` (rolling restart).

michael: also bumping replica count from 4 -> 8 to absorb backlog while we stabilize: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-worker --replicas=8 -n inference`

customer-success: reporting that several customers are seeing failures for bulk-embedding jobs. We have 4 active customer tickets opened in the last 10m, some affected users report 502s on batch endpoints.

alice: after shadow off + restarts, error-rate down to ~8% and trending down. p95 latency improving.

michael: checking upstream model-server logs — no obvious OOM there. The kvcache eviction messages correlate with traffic pattern when quantized model was shadowed. Looks like new kernel path triggers excessive segment allocation under our current cache size.

sam: agree. Savepoint: revert rollout entirely from canary control plane to be safe. Filing rollback: `rollout revert rollout/qz-embeds-2026-03`

pagerbot: rollback executed. Canary traffic removed.

michael: adding temporary mitigation: reduce max_batch_size from 512 -> 128 in embed-worker config to reduce memory pressure. Applying config: `kubectl set env deploy/embed-worker MAX_BATCH=128 -n inference`

alice: config applied. Observability shows KV cache events falling. Error-rate back to baseline ~0.6% after ~7m.

customer-success: update posted to affected customers: "We're seeing intermittent 5xx on embeddings; mitigation in progress. We rolled back a recent model rollout and service is recovering. We'll follow up with root cause. Apologies for the disruption."

michael: root-cause hypothesis: quantized model variant triggered a new kernel/cache path that increases segment allocation; under production traffic this caused kvcache eviction flood and worker restarts -> 5xx. Need an RCA with alloc traces and repro.

sam: created an issue in infra repo: https://git.example/r/infra/issues/987 — assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime. Include allocation profiles, reproducer steps, and canary config.

pagerbot: PD incident status -> acknowledged -> resolved (monitoring). Auto-notify in 30m for follow-up.

michael: leaving a short post-incident checklist: 1) keep shadow routing disabled for qz rollout until we've repro locally, 2) add guardrail to block rollout if kvcache evictions spike >5% during shadow runs, 3) add telemetry to sample allocation histograms, 4) post RCA in #incidents and notify customers.

alice: handing off to next oncall in 20m — leaving logs and links in the incident ticket.

customer-success: thanks team — will update customers and keep tickets open until RCA. :thumbsup:
